# Persia

> Persia is a free arcade shooter that runs in the browser. You shoot down five waves of angry animals and then a giant cat, and each animal's name is spoken in Persian when it first shows up.

The seven animals are dog, cat, horse, cow, fish, bird and rabbit. When a species arrives in a wave, a voice says its Persian name once and the word appears large over the fight for about a second, each letter in its own colour. The menus and the score are in English. It opens like a film: the lights go down and eyes blink open in the dark around the title. When the giant falls, the seven animals parade past, each named once more, and then come the score and "Again". Spread shot, laser, rapid fire, shield and smart bombs drop along the way. It is made for a laptop or desktop with a keyboard and mouse.

Every clip is synthesised speech that a native Persian speaker approved before it went in; the game never synthesises speech itself. It is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript ES modules with no dependencies, no build step and no network requests at runtime. Made by Babak Bandpey at Cocode, released under Apache-2.0.

## Play

- [Persia](https://persia.cocode.dk/): the game itself; keyboard and mouse
